messages:
Jules (PM): Quick sync — after the GA spike, we need to pick two items for the next 2-week mini-sprint: one reliability/bug fix and one customer-facing enhancement. Can folks throw up candidate items + rough cost?
Ravi (Eng): My top bug candidate is the chat streaming truncation — repro: start long prompt + interrupt, sometimes tokens stop mid-sentence. Repro steps in last runbook. Estimated 3 dev-days + 1 day of canary/rollout.
Iris (CS): +1 for truncation, hit from 3 paying customers (enterprise). They see truncated summaries, losing context. One customer provided logs and a minimal reproduction.
Connor (Design): For enhancement, propose "preserve paragraph breaks" option in the formatter so long outputs don't flatten — small UX win for docs customers. Mock is 1 day of design + 2 dev-days.
Maya (SRE): Observability: p99 latency spike on model-hosting correlates with the truncation incidents around large prefix sizes. We can do temporary routing to smaller-seq model as mitigation. Cost: config change + tests (~1 day).
Ravi (Eng): Quick note: fix path could be two parts — 1) guardrail to avoid mid-token cutoff (quick) 2) deeper root-cause (kernel/kv-cache) (bigger). We could ship the guardrail in 3 days and schedule root-cause for follow-up.
Jules (PM): Sounds like consensus forming. Proposal: pick guardrail fix for truncation (owner: Ravi) + "preserve paragraph breaks" (owner: Connor + Ravi). Ship as a paired mini-sprint. Acceptance criteria:
- Truncation guardrail: no customer repros in staging after 24h of high-load fuzzing, metrics: truncation count <= 1% of baseline and p99 latency not regressing.
- Paragraph-preserve: opt-in API param / console toggle + automated tests + docs sample.
Ravi (Eng): I'll draft the PR and a test harness. Quick pseudo:
```
// guardrail: if (kv_cache_gap > threshold) flush_prefix();
```
Will add metrics tags so SRE can see changes.
Maya (SRE): Can we add a short-term routing rule? If request_seq_len > 2048 route to model-x-small as fallback. I can run a canary for 6 hours, watch p99 and error-rate.
Iris (CS): I'll notify the three customers about planned mitigation + ask for test payloads. Also will collect any additional repros.
Connor (Design): For the paragraph-preserve option, I'll post mocks in figma and a short copy for docs today.
Jules (PM): Timeline: start Monday sprint day 1. Target: guardrail merged + canary by Wed; paragraph option behind flag by end of week 2. If guardrail slips, we escalate to outage channel.
Ravi (Eng): FYI: there's a flaky unit around kv eviction — might need extra pairing. Calling @Maya for pairing on Monday.
Maya (SRE): Ack. I'll draft canary runbook and add dashboard: "truncation.count", "response.p99", "routing.fallback_rate".
release-bot: Release window booked: 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC canary -> 2026-03-31 06:00 UTC gradual. See: https://releases.example/5178
Jules (PM): Action items:
- Ravi: PR + test harness (owner)
- Maya: Canary runbook + dashboard (owner)
- Connor: Figma + docs copy (owner)
- Iris: customer comms + repro collection (owner)
Also please tag the tickets: BUG-2743 (truncation guardrail), FEAT-6621 (paragraph-preserve). Update Jira board before EOD. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng): Will update tickets and ping when draft PR is up.
Iris (CS): I'll send comms draft into #customer-comm for review.
Connor (Design): Posting mocks in 10m.
Maya (SRE): Starting dashboard and smoke scripts now.
Jules (PM): Thanks team — we'll do a short async grooming at 10:30 to lock scope. If anyone thinks we should swap the enhancement for a higher-impact bug, say now.
Connor (Design): Should be fine. :ok_hand:
Ravi (Eng): Good to go.
Iris (CS): :thumbsup:
